name: pie-chart
purpose: Accessible SVG pie and donut chart for a single part-to-whole breakdown: slices in data order from 12 o'clock, percentage labels, a legend listing every share, keyboard-reachable slices with tooltips, a generated summary, and a data table fallback.
whenToUse: One breakdown of a total into a few (2-6) parts.
Donut: when the total (center label) matters as much as the parts.
whenNotToUse: Comparing many parts or similar sizes: use Bar Chart (lengths compare more accurately than angles).
Comparing several breakdowns: use a stacked Bar Chart.
responsive: The pie fits the smaller of the container width and the height option, centered. Slice labels are printed only where they fit. Reflows at 320 CSS px.
rtl: Slices keep their clockwise order (a pie has no reading axis); ArrowLeft/ArrowRight are swapped in RTL so "forward" follows the reading direction. Legend, tooltip, and table follow the document direction.
theme: Slices use color-chart-1..8 by palette slot with a color-surface separator and color-surface textures; labels color-text with a color-surface halo; center label color-text. Forced colors use CanvasText, Canvas, and Highlight.
security: All text (title, description, labels, values, tooltip, table) is set with textContent; SVG is built with createElementNS. Colors are CSS classes; sizes and the tooltip position are written through the CSSOM (style.setProperty). No innerHTML, no style attributes, no inline handlers: works under style-src without unsafe-inline and require-trusted-types-for.
dataHandling: Renders the data it is given; no persistence, network access, or telemetry. Values are not logged; validation errors name the option, never its value.

budgets.metric: PieChart.create with 12 slices (pie and donut), including the first render
budgets.budget: < 15 ms in headless Chromium (e2e performance test, median of 5)

performance.testedScale: Designed for up to about 12 slices; more work but become unreadable (colors repeat after 8).

limitations: Negative values cannot be drawn and are excluded from the pie (listed as not plotted).
Slices start at 12 o'clock in data order; sorting is the consumer's choice.
Slice labels are hidden for slices narrower than about 17 degrees.
unsupported: Exploded slices, nested (sunburst) or multi-ring donuts.
antiPatterns: Several pies side by side for comparison.
Omitting percentages and legend (patterns and labels are the non-color cues).
